text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly selling Stock E at large gains has rewarded me emotionally, but I should avoid trimming automatically and weigh its outlook and portfolio role before each sale.","Buying more Stock B at a higher price should be based on updated fundamentals and risk, not on anchoring to my earlier purchase or trying to validate it.","My account value can fluctuate even when I trade little; I should assess total portfolio risk and cash needs rather than treating each stock’s gain or loss from my cost as the whole decision."]}
